news.title: Jamie Dimon says Anthropic's Mythos reveals 'a lot more vulnerabilities' for cyberattacks
news.summary: The remarks show how a technology welcomed by corporations as a productivity boon can also pose serious threats, like uncovering new ways to hack into systems.

news.title: Prediction markets will grow to $1 trillion by 2030, Bernstein estimates
news.summary: The investment bank said volumes will reach an estimated $240 billion in 2026 and grow at a 80% compound annual rate between 2025 and 2030.

news.title: Chinese robotaxi companies forge ahead with UAE expansion despite Iran war
news.summary: Ride-hailing company Didi plans to begin its first overseas robotaxi test in the United Arab Emirates later this year.

news.title: Bank of America tops estimates as CEO Brian Moynihan says consumer banking is 'healthy'
news.summary: Bank of America, the second-largest U.S. bank by assets, has topped expectations for earnings per share for 23 consecutive quarters.

news.title: Morgan Stanley tops estimates as trading revenue exceeds expectations by nearly $1 billion
news.summary: Morgan Stanley's results in the quarter were powered by the firm's fixed income and equities trading operations, which produced about $8.5 billion in revenue.
